fact: The SNDS 2022-2026, dated January 2023, lists its elaboration and adoption by the government among the national statistical system's opportunities; it is a five-year strategy with a 26,129.4 million FCFA action plan. The document gives no adoption date, so its own date is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2022-2026.
